来读读这本讲夜空的宇宙学书吧！
counselor: The school counselor helps kids at our school.
学校的辅导老师会帮助同学们。
Did you see the camp counselor by the lake?
你看见湖边的营地辅导员了吗？
Ask the counselor if you need help!
需要帮助就去问辅导员吧！
counterfeit: A counterfeit toy is not good for kids.
假冒玩具对小朋友可不好。
How do you know it is counterfeit?
你怎么知道它是假冒的呢？
counterfeiter: The counterfeiter in the story is not nice.
故事里的造假家伙可不是好人。
Who stopped the counterfeiter in the story?
故事里是谁抓住了造假的家伙呀？
Never buy things from a counterfeiter!
千万别买造假家伙的东西！
counterpart: This glove is the counterpart of that glove.
这只手套和那只正好是一对。
Did you find the counterpart of your shoe?
你找到和你那只配对的鞋了吗？
Find the counterpart of this little sock!
把这只小袜子的另一只找出来吧！
countryside: My grandmother lives in the green countryside.
我奶奶住在绿油油的乡下。
Do you like the countryside or the city?
你喜欢乡下还是城市呀？
Let's take the train to the countryside!
courage: It takes courage to swim in the cold lake.
在冰凉的湖里游泳，可得有勇气呢。
Where do you find your courage?
你的勇气是从哪儿来的呀？
Have courage and try the big slide!
鼓起勇气，去试试那个大滑梯吧！
courtesy: Saying thank you is good courtesy.
说谢谢是有礼貌的好表现。
Do you say hello with courtesy every day?
你每天都礼貌地问好吗？
Use courtesy with your friends and family!
对朋友和家人都要讲礼貌哦！
courtier: The courtier in the story has a fine coat.
故事里的朝臣穿着一件华丽的外套。
Is the courtier in the story good or bad?
故事里的朝臣是好人还是坏人呀？
What a fine coat the courtier has!
朝臣的这件外套可真华丽呀！
cove: The little boat sits in the green cove.
小船停在青山绿水的小海湾里。
Did you swim in the cove by the cliff?
你在悬崖边的小海湾里游过泳吗？
Look for crabs in the little cove!
到小海湾里去找小螃蟹吧！
covet: The big dog covets the little dog's ball.
大狗狗眼馋小狗狗的皮球。
Do you covet the biggest present under the tree?
树下那个最大的礼物，你是不是特别眼馋呀？
Do not covet your friend's new toy.
别眼馋朋友的新玩具哦。
coveted: The big cupcake is the most coveted snack.
那个大纸杯蛋糕是最抢手的点心。
Is that the most coveted toy at the store?
那是店里最抢手的玩具吗？
Wow, the most coveted seat is by the window!
哇，最抢手的座位是靠窗的那个！
covetous: The covetous fox looks at the pie.
贪心的狐狸盯着那块派看。
Why does the covetous crow want the cookie?
贪心的乌鸦为什么想要那块饼干呀？
Do not be a covetous kid!
cradle: The baby sleeps in the little cradle.
小宝宝在小小的摇篮里睡着了。
Did your mother sing by your cradle?
你小时候，妈妈在摇篮边给你唱过歌吗？
Rock the cradle and sing a song!
craftsmanship: The old boat has very good craftsmanship.
那条旧船做工可精细了。
Did you see the craftsmanship in the old house?
你注意到老房子里的精细做工了吗？
What fine craftsmanship in this old chair!
这把旧椅子的手艺真棒呀！
craven: The craven fox runs from the little mouse.
胆小的狐狸见了小老鼠都撒腿就跑。
Why is the craven bunny under the bed?
胆小的小兔子为什么躲到床底下呀？
Don't be a craven, little bunny!
crawdad: The crawdad sits under a rock in the pond.
螯虾一动不动地待在池塘的石头下面。
Did you see a crawdad at the lake today?
今天你在湖边看到螯虾了吗？
Wow, the crawdad has so many legs!
crease: There is a crease in my new shirt.
我的新衬衫上有一道折痕。
Did you make that big crease in the map?
地图上那道大折痕是你弄出来的吗？
别把漂亮的衬衫压出褶子呀！
creativity: 画彩虹是需要创造力的。
Does drawing animals take a lot of creativity?
画动物是不是特别考验创造力呀？
Use your creativity and make a new game!
发挥你的创造力，设计个新游戏吧！
credible: The old story about the fox is not credible.
那个老公狐狸的故事不太可信。
Is his story about the big fish credible?
他讲的大鱼的事可信吗？
Please tell a credible story this time.
这次讲个真实可信的故事吧。
credit: She got the credit for the clean classroom.
教室打扫干净，功劳都记在她头上。
Do you want the credit for the nice drawing?
这张漂亮的画，你想不想领功呀？
Give your team credit for the good work!
队伍干得好，要给队友记一功哦！
credulity: Too much credulity is not good for you.
太容易轻信别人，对你没好处。
Does the fox in the story use your credulity?
故事里的狐狸是不是在利用你的轻信呀？
Ask more and more to stop your credulity!
多问几句，就不会轻易上当啦！
creepy: That big black spider looks so creepy.
那只黑乎乎的大蜘蛛看着怪吓人的。
Is that creepy noise coming from the closet?
那阵吓人的声音是从衣柜里传出来的吗？
Don't watch the creepy movie at night!
晚上别看吓人的电影哦！
crenellated: The old fort has a crenellated wall.
古老的堡垒有一圈带垛口的墙。
Is that crenellated building very, very old?
那座带城垛的建筑是不是特别古老呀？
Draw the crenellated fort in your art book!
在你的美术本上画画带垛口的堡垒吧！
crescendo: The music goes up in a big crescendo.
音乐渐渐加强，越来越响。
Did you hear the big crescendo in the song?
歌里那阵渐强的最高潮你听到了吗？
哇，这渐强的高潮真有气势！
crest: The wave's crest is white and high.
浪尖白白的，高高地卷起来。
Can you swim over the crest of a wave?
Look at the white crest on that wave!
快看那个浪头白色的浪尖！
crevasse: A big crevasse opens in the old ice.
古老的冰面上裂开了一道大冰缝。
Can you see the crevasse in the white snow?
你能看见白雪里的那道冰裂缝吗？
Do not walk near the crevasse!
crisis: The little rain is not a big crisis.
下点小雨，算不上什么大危机。
What will you do in a little crisis?
遇到点小危机，你会怎么办呢？
Don't cry about a small crisis!
criticize: My brother does not like to be criticized.
我哥哥不喜欢被人批评。
Why do you criticize my old backpack?
你干嘛要批评我的旧书包呀？
Do not criticize others too much!
别把别人批评得太狠哦！
